That information isn't available in the policies I have access to. I can confirm from **kb/09-account-faq.md** that Trailforge does have a loyalty program where you earn **1 point per dollar spent**, and that points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders — but the specific redemption rates (such as how many points equal $10 off) are not included in the policy excerpts I have available.

For the exact redemption details, I'd recommend:
- Checking your **account dashboard**, which may display your points balance and redemption options
- Visiting the loyalty/rewards section of the Trailforge website

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Your case has been escalated! Here's what happens next:

- A **specialist will review your case and follow up within one business day**.
- They'll verify the color discrepancy and determine the appropriate resolution.
- Please have any photos of the item and packaging ready, as that may help speed things along (per **kb/10-damaged-defective.md**).

I cannot promise a specific outcome, but the team will be in touch shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with in the meantime?

Great question! Based on our return policy, you have **30 days from the delivery date** to return most items for a full refund. Since your jacket was delivered last week, you should still have plenty of time within that window.

Here are a few things to keep in mind for your return (per **kb/01-return-policy.md**):

- The jacket must be **unused, in original packaging, and in resalable condition**
- You'll need your **order number or original receipt**
- Since this is a standard return (change of mind), **return shipping costs are your responsibility**

**To get started**, just reach out to us with your order number and reason for the return — we'll confirm eligibility, send a return authorization, and provide shipping instructions. *(kb/07-returns-process-faq.md)*

Once we receive and inspect the jacket, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within **5–7 business days**. Would you like help initiating the return?
